queries: WITH per_source AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS src_size FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), overall AS (SELECT AVG(src_size) AS avg_size FROM per_source) SELECT AVG(ps.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_ratios, SUM(ps.src_size) AS combined_size, AVG(ps.src_size - o.avg_size) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM per_source ps CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ps.src_size > o.avg_size

WITH per_source AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, SUM(s.aream2) AS src_size FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), overall AS (SELECT AVG(src_size) AS avg_size FROM per_source) SELECT AVG(ps.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_ratios, SUM(ps.src_size) AS combined_size, AVG(ps.src_size - o.avg_size) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM per_source ps CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ps.src_size > o.avg_size

WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS size FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT src, avg_ratio, size, AVG(size * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_size FROM g) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(size) AS combined_size, AVG(size - avg_size) AS avg_excess_over_avg_size FROM a WHERE size > avg_size

assumptions.assumption: A funding source's 'size' is the number of scanspatial records linked to its projects (all records counted, including those with a missing or zero boxy/boxz).
A NULL fundflux forms its own group (GROUP BY treats NULLs as one group).
Missing ratios are ignored via AVG skipping NULLs; boxz = 0 is treated as missing through NULLIF to avoid division by zero.

The 'average of their ratios' is the unweighted mean of the per-source average ratios, and the average size is the unweighted mean of per-source sizes. Only projects with at least one spatial record are included (inner join).

alternatives.interpretation: Size means the total surface area (sum of aream2) of the spatial records for each funding source, rather than the record count.

assumptions.assumption: A funding source's 'size' is the number of scanspatial records linked to its projects. Records with a missing ratio still count toward size.
A missing fundflux is its own group, which GROUP BY already does with NULLs. The 'average size across funding sources' is the unweighted mean of the per-source sizes, with each group counted once.
The ratio is boxy/boxz per record. Records where boxz is 0 or boxy or boxz is NULL are ignored in the average, and an inner join drops scanspatial rows with no matching project.

alternatives.interpretation: Size means the total volume (volm3) of the spatial records per funding source, not the record count.
